title: Higher direct images of modules as sheafified cohomology of preimages; stalks
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $p\ge0$, with higher direct image $R^pf_*\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-cohomology]. Then $R^pf_*\mathcal F$ is the sheaf associated [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] to the presheaf of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $V\mapsto H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F|_{f^{-1}(V)})$, whose restriction maps are the restrictions of [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] (b); that is, there is a morphism of presheaves from this presheaf to $R^pf_*\mathcal F$ which is universal among morphisms to sheaves. Consequently, for $y\in Y$ the induced map $\varinjlim_{V\ni y}H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)\to(R^pf_*\mathcal F)_y$ from the stalk of the presheaf to the stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-modules. For $p=0$, $R^0f_*\mathcal F=f_*\mathcal F$.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01E4 (lemma-describe-higher-direct-images, line 590), with Sheaves, Lemma 007Z (sheaves-lemma-stalk-sheafification) for the stalks
